authority: JAYT-388 — directive supplied directly by user
reviewer: Codex CEO; Gemini actual artifact review

authorization.scope: Collect R2 artifacts, implement corrections and deploy completed verified scope to named production. Affiliate activation is approved only for each provider that has both matching SKU artifacts and a provider-issued/replayable attribution validation.

tasks: Capture 30 exact product leaf-page artifacts from official Mall domains into 06_TRUST_AND_EVIDENCE/j387/raw_snapshots/. Each snapshot must be original bytes from the observed response, named by itemId and capture timestamp. Do not synthesize, edit, compose or manually reconstruct snapshots.

Store 30 corresponding original product images only when their official source, product/variant relationship and display/use rights are documented. Place source assets under 03_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH/assets/products/ and record source URL, capture time, MIME type, dimensions and SHA-256 measured from the on-disk file. Do not hotlink production cards to partner CDN.

Write sku_leaf files only after physical artifacts exist. Every leaf includes relative snapshot path/hash, image path/hash, response capture metadata, URL, merchant, product/variant, price, availability, delivery conditions and a source-extracted text excerpt. Build fails if an artifact is absent, changes hash or does not match the immutable registry.

Use a labelled neutral placeholder for items that cannot be captured legitimately. Report exact captured/placeholder count. Never represent a login page, challenge page, generic catalogue page or search result as product evidence.

Respect provider terms, robots/rate limits and access controls. Do not defeat CAPTCHA, authentication, paywalls, geo controls or bot protections. A blocked capture is a missing artifact, not proof that the product has ended.
Change HTTP 3xx in health worker to status UNKNOWN with suppress_purchase false. AVAILABLE must mean HTTP 200 only. Add unit tests for 301, 302, 307 and 308 plus 200, 404, 410, 403, 429 and timeout.

Measure the 3-app slider using 50 real input-to-render samples on a declared physical mobile device/browser. Capture raw samples, calculation method, device/browser/CPU conditions, p50/p95/max and screenshots/video if available. A zero-sample measurement fails.
Preserve itemId-only validation, strict unknown-field rejection, DNS mixed-answer denial, IP pinning and no outbound request on rejected input.

Collect 15 independently dated Da Nang-applicable F&B/cinema deal artifacts. Each needs an original source/poster/branch record, source URL, capture time/hash, effective dates, eligibility, redemption steps and a semantic CTA.

Requested brands/offers are acquisition targets only: Phe La BOGO, Katinat, Highlands app reduction, Metiz U22 55K, Galaxy 50K and Starlight 45K. Publish only when current evidence confirms its exact terms and local applicability.

Copy-code CTA requires a real public code from the artifact. App/counter/member CTA must match its actual redemption route. Do not describe an ordinary menu price, membership program or expired campaign as a shock deal.

For each provider requested for affiliate activation, capture a redacted provider-issued test response or reporting record that proves the exact attributed URL resolves to the exact SKU and attribution is accepted. A partner ID in config or manually assembled redirect URL is insufficient.
Enable affiliate_enabled only for passing providers/SKUs; keep other providers in direct official-link mode and disclose that destination accurately. Never count clicks as revenue.
At least 30 matching SKU artifacts alone do not establish commercial attribution. Record provider scope/count and unresolved providers.

build_and_release_gate: Run registry-to-UI-to-worker-to-evidence equality check and artifact-presence/hash validator; include six mutation cases (ID, URL, variant, price, media, missing snapshot).
Audit every physical image manually against its product/variant; decode image bytes and reject generic/reused/mismatched media.
Run security suite including 3xx semantics; benchmark has 50 non-zero observations; enforce all raw snapshot and deal artifact paths.
Verify 1440/768/390, no console errors/overflow, Campus Dock/filter, comparator, 15 qualified deals and Zalo Pass PNG. Bind hashes to served bytes and check HTTP200 endpoints.
Record actual Gemini review tied to deployment/artifacts; executor may prepare a packet only and cannot assert Gemini PASS.

reporting.ack: Record actual ACK and start time.
reporting.progress: Within the work period report artifact count, real-photo count, current deal count, provider attribution-ready count, blocked captures and exact reasons.
reporting.completion: Report only artifacts that physically exist and verify. Keep provisional status for unmet evidence or unverified provider attribution.
